name: dsh-web-fetch-playwright
description: Playwright/CDP web-fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness: renders pages in a real browser, denoises them (Readability + DOMPurify), and returns markdown.

permissions: network:fetch (renders the URLs the user requests in a local browser)
network:connect (user-configured outbound PROXY: traffic from the browser this plugin launches — or from a CDP browser started with --proxy-server — egresses through that hop, whose operator sees it)
fs:write (DSH-managed backend: the persistent browser profile under the configured user-data-dir — cookies, localStorage, logins — which this plugin never cleans)

fs:write (network capture, when recordNetwork is on: writes network.jsonl and a HAR 1.2 har.json into the configured recordDir — default <cwd>/net-dumps/<sessionId>, directory 0700 / files 0600 — containing PLAINTEXT Cookie/Token/Authorization headers and response bodies, kept until you delete them)
process:spawn (bin/launch-browser.mjs only: the local GUI launcher runs the browser it is pointed at, after copying the profile to a throwaway directory)
network:fetch (CDP profile mode: renders the URLs the user requests WITH the remote browser's logged-in sessions)
disclosure.retention: none for rendered content; the DSH-managed backend keeps its user-data-dir profile on disk (cookies, localStorage, logins) until you delete it; the local launcher's profile COPY is yours and is never cleaned by this plugin; CDP profile mode leaves site data in the remote browser's own user-data-dir
